event_name.description: IFTTT Webhooks event name (the 'maker' trigger). Must be present in the operator's IFTTT allowlist; arbitrary event names are rejected at lease time.

value1.description: First positional IFTTT value (maps to {{Value1}} in the applet).

extra.description: Optional JSON object body (IFTTT Pro / Webhooks JSON variant). When supplied, value1/2/3 are still forwarded for compatibility.

delivered.description: True when IFTTT's webhook endpoint returned 2xx. IFTTT does not report whether the applet's downstream action actually succeeded — only that the trigger was accepted.

response_excerpt.description: First 512 bytes of IFTTT's response body, for diagnostics.

summary: Bridge a mesh event to an IFTTT Webhooks ('maker') trigger so downstream applets fire. Event-name allowlist enforced at lease issuance.
notes: IFTTT's trigger acknowledgement does not guarantee the downstream applet succeeded. For receipts that need end-to-end confirmation, pair with a verification capability against the target system (e.g. read-back from the destination).
